title: Iníon an fhoghlaí mhara
style: Electroswing, bright processed female vocal with heavy compression and slight slapback delay, syncopated trumpet and trombone stabs, synthesized upright bass, swing piano, 124 BPM four-on-the-floor drive with crisp high-frequency snare, vinyl crackle, glitchy scratches, sudden filter sweeps and momentary silences in F minor
lyrics:
[Intro]
[four-on-the-floor kick drum, vinyl crackle, staccato brass stabs]
Níor thogh Gláidial a saol —
[record scratch]
iníon an fhoghlaí mhara,
[full band enters, walking synth bass, swing piano]
bean ag cibé fear a roghnódh a hathair,
ach éan saor uaibhreach go dtiocfadh an lá.

[Chorus]
[processed female vocals, bright brass section]
Níor thogh Gláidial an saol eile seo —
an cime, an dalta, an compánach,

[Outro]
[filter sweep on brass]
an bhean taobh thiar de ríchathaoir i gcéin,
an bhean le ríchathaoir deataigh dá cuid féin.
